question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

No longer in existence or use
solution:
The correct answer is: **Obsolete**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Obsolete"** means something that is no longer in use or no longer useful; it is out of date. (अप्रचलित)

 
 
• **Example: **Many old technologies, such as VHS tapes, have become **obsolete** in the digital age.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the word describing something that is no longer in existence or use is **"Obsolete"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Omnipotent **(सर्वशक्तिमान): Having unlimited power; able to do anything.

 
 
• **Example:** In many myths, the gods are** omnipotent** beings capable of incredible feats.
 
 
 
• **Outpour **(उद्गार): Something that streams out rapidly.
 
 
• **Example: **There was an** outpour **of emotions at the farewell party.
 
 
 
• **Obscure** (अस्पष्ट): Not well-known; not clear or hard to understand.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were so** obscure **that no one could follow them correctly.
